title: 47 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Cultural Traditions)
description:
Learn 47 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 47 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Cultural Traditions · 文化传统
1:29  Creativity · 创造力
2:47  Motivation · 动力
4:16  Agreeing & Disagreeing · 同意与反对
5:39  Positive Life · 积极人生
6:57  Confidence · 自信
8:15  Travel & Airport · 旅行与机场
9:25  Making Plans · 制定计划

PHRASE LIST

CULTURAL TRADITIONS · 文化传统
• During Qingming, we sweep tombs - 清明节我们去给亲人扫墓  [QingMING JE wo men qu gei qin ren sao MU]
• We burn joss paper for ancestors - 我们会给祖先烧纸钱  [wo men hui gei zu xian shao ZHI qian]
• At temple fairs, we light lanterns - 庙会上大家一起点灯笼  [miao SHANG da jia yi qi dian deng LONG]
• On Chinese Valentine’s, we write wishes - 七夕夜我们写下愿望贴起来  [Qi xi ye wo men xie xia yuan wang tie qi lai]
• At the Lantern Festival, we solve riddles - 元宵节我们猜灯谜  [yuan xiao jie wo men cai deng MI]
• We drink tea for respect at banquets - 吃饭前先敬一杯茶表示礼貌  [chi FAN qian xian jing yi bei cha biao shi li mao]

CREATIVITY · 创造力
• Make something from ordinary days - 把普通日子做成作品  [bǎ pǔtōng rìzi zuò chéng zuòpǐn]
• Turn doubts into drafts, quietly - 把怀疑写进草稿里  [bǎ huáiyí xiě jìn cǎogǎo lǐ]
• Steal ideas, not the feeling - 借灵感也要留住自己  [jiè línggǎn yě yào liú zhù zìjǐ]
• Practice saying the strange version - 练习说更离奇的那种  [liànxí shuō gèng líqí de nà zhǒng]
• Write, then cut, then keep - 先写下，再删减，再留下  [xiān xiě xià, zài shānjiǎn, zài liúxià]
• Build a mini story from scratch - 从零开始写一个小故事  [cóng líng kāishǐ xiě yí gè xiǎo gùshì]

MOTIVATION · 动力
• Morning, I choose Chinese energy. - 早上，我选择中文的动力。  [Zǎo shang, WO xuǎnzé zhōngwén de DÒnglì.]
• Two minutes, start the engine. - 两分钟就够了，先把动力启动起来。  [Liǎng fēn zhōng jiù gòu le, xiān bǎ DÒnglì qǐdòng qǐlái.]
• Make it practical, not perfect. - 别追求完美，先把实用动力做出来。  [Bié zhuīqiú wánměi, xiān bǎ shíyòng DÒnglì zuò chūlái.]
• I study because I want freedom. - 我学中文，是为了自由的动力。  [Wǒ xué zhōngwén, shì wèile zìyóu de DÒnglì.]
• Call a friend, speak a line. - 给朋友发条消息，先讲一句就有动力。  [Gěi péngyou fā tiáo xiāoxī, xiān jiǎng yí jù jiù yǒu DÒnglì.]
• Turn friction into fuel today. - 有点卡也没关系，把阻力变成燃料。  [Yǒudiǎn kǎ yě méi guānxi, bǎ zǔlì biàn chéng ránliào.]

AGREEING & DISAGREEING · 同意与反对
• Sounds good to me, let's go - 听起来不错，我们就这么办吧  [Tīng qǐlái búcuò, wǒmen jiù zhème bàn ba]
• I like that idea, honestly - 说真的，我挺喜欢这个主意的  [Shuō zhēn de, wǒ tǐng xǐhuan zhège zhǔyi de]
• Okay, I can accept that - 行吧，这个我可以接受  [Xíng ba, zhège wǒ kěyǐ jiēshòu]
• That’s convincing, you’ve got a point - 你说得挺有说服力的，我承认  [Nǐ shuō de tǐng yǒu shuōfú lì de, wǒ chéngrèn]
• I partly agree, but not fully - 我同意一部分，但我不完全认同  [Wǒ tóngyì yí bùfen, dàn wǒ bù wánquán rèn tóng]
• I disagree, I think that’s risky - 我不同意，我觉得这太冒险了  [Wǒ bù tóngyì, wǒ juéde zhè tài màoxiǎn le]

POSITIVE LIFE · 积极人生
• Do it scared, then again. - 害怕也去做, 然后再做一遍.  [HAI-PA YE QÙ ZUÒ, RÁN-HÒU ZAI ZUÒ YI-BIÀN.]
• One message can brighten today. - 发一条问候, 就能照亮今天.  [FĀ YI TIÁO WÈNHÒU, JIÙ NENG ZHAO-LIÀNG JIN-TIĀN.]
• Turn worry into a quick plan. - 把担心变成一个小计划.  [BĂ DĀN-XIN BIÀN-CHÉNG YI-GE XIĂO JI-HUÀ.]
• Ask for help, respectfully. - 礼貌地求助, 你不是负担.  [LǏ-MÀO DI QIÚ-ZHÙ, NǏ BÚ SHÌ FÙ-DĀN.]
• Say yes to water and sleep. - 答应自己多喝水, 多睡觉.  [DÁ-YÌNG ZÌ-JǏ DUŌ HĒ-SHUǏ, DUŌ SHUÌ-JIÀO.]
• Keep your promises to your dreams. - 对梦想也要守信用.  [DUÌ MÈNG-XIÀNG YĚO SHǑU XÌN-YÒNG.]

CONFIDENCE · 自信
• I start before I feel ready. - 我先开始, 再慢慢变得自信。  [Wo xian kaishi, zai manman biande zixin.]
• My effort will speak for me. - 我的努力会说话。  [Wo de nuli hui shuohua.]
• I can ask, and still lead. - 我可以提问, 但我仍然在掌控。  [Wo keyi tiwen, dan wo renglai zai zhǎngkòng.]
• No one knows my plan but me. - 只有我知道我的计划。  [Zhǐyou wo zhīdào wo de jihua.]
• I trust my process, not perfection. - 我相信我的过程, 不追求完美。  [Wo xiangxin wo de guocheng, bu zhuiqiu wanmei.]
• I take a breath and choose calm. - 我深呼吸, 然后选择从容。  [Wo shen-huxi, ranhou xuǎnze cong-rong.]

TRAVEL & AIRPORT · 旅行与机场
• Where's the customs exit? - 海关出口在哪儿？  [Hǎiguān chūkǒu zài nǎ'er?]
• I have too much carry-on. - 我随身行李太多了。  [Wǒ suíshēn xínglǐ tài duō le.]
• Do I need to scan my passport? - 我需要扫描护照吗？  [Wǒ xūyào sǎomiáo hùzhào ma?]
• Is there a water refill station? - 这里有加水站吗？  [Zhèlǐ yǒu jiā shuǐ zhàn ma?]
• Can I change to an earlier flight? - 我能改到更早的航班吗？  [Wǒ néng gǎi dào gèng zǎo de hángbān ma?]
• Where is the lost and found desk? - 失物招领在什么地方？  [Shīwù zhāolǐng zài shénme dìfang?]

MAKING PLANS · 制定计划
• Let s set weekly milestones - 我们把每周的里程碑定下来吧。  [Wo men ba mei zhou de lǐ chéng bēi dìng xià lái ba.]
